<<<JSON
{
  "summary_plain": "The shortener works end-to-end: you can paste a URL on the dark 'Tool' page (matching the approved sketch exactly), optionally give it a custom name, get a short link back, and opening that link redirects immediately while the open count and 'last opened' time update on the page. Unknown codes show a plain 'Not found' page. Codes are cryptographically random and effectively unguessable. The light 'friendly' design and its /_alt route were removed as agreed, there's still no login, and no delete/edit/pagination was added — all as planned. The full automated test suite passes. The only thing not literally watched in a browser is the green/red confirmation message on the form, which was verified by reading the code and testing the API directly instead of a live screenshot.",
  "delivered": [
    { "promise": "Shorten links: POST a URL, get a short code, optional custom alias, URL validation", "status": "done", "note": "Validates http/https only, alias pattern-checked and race-safe 409 on collision" },
    { "promise": "Redirect: GET /:code returns 302 to the original URL; 404 for unknown codes", "status": "done", "note": "Indexed lookup; click recording failure can't block the redirect (tested)" },
    { "promise": "Click stats: count opens with timestamp, endpoint listing links with counts", "status": "done", "note": "GET /api/links returns clicks + lastClickAt, computed in SQL" },
    { "promise": "Minimal web page: form + table of links with counts, matching the 'Tool' sketch", "status": "done", "note": "Screenshots compared directly against the approved sketch — layout matches, including mobile column drop" },
    { "promise": "Green success / red error message on the form", "status": "done", "note": "Verified by reading the submit handler and testing the API's error responses directly, not by watching it in a live browser" },
    { "promise": "Codes unguessable / not trivially enumerable", "status": "done", "note": "7 chars from a 56-char alphabet via crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling; ~1.7 trillion combinations" },
    { "promise": "Light 'friendly' design and /_alt route removed", "status": "done", "note": "Confirmed absent from the codebase; a test asserts /_alt now 404s" },
    { "promise": "No login; open to anyone who reaches the port", "status": "done", "note": "No auth code anywhere in the server" },
    { "promise": "No delete/edit/pagination; links never expire", "status": "done", "note": "Confirmed absent, as intentionally decided before building" },
    { "promise": "Full automated test suite (npm test)", "status": "done", "note": "Recorded checks show npm test passing; covers shortening, redirects, counting, validation" },
    { "promise": "Node 24+ requirement recorded, zero runtime dependencies", "status": "done", "note": "package.json engines field set; only dev dependencies present" }
  ],
  "how_to_see": [
    "Run `npm install` then `npm start` in the project directory",
    "Open http://localhost:8080 in a browser — shorten a URL, note the short link",
    "Open the short link in a new tab, confirm it redirects, then reload the main page and see the open count and 'last open' time update",
    "Try a bogus code like http://localhost:8080/zzzzzzz to see the 'Not found' page",
    "Run `npm test` to see the full suite pass"
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "The form's success/error message was verified by code reading and direct API calls, not a live screenshot, due to a headless-browser cross-origin limitation. Low risk; worth a 30-second manual check."
  ]
}
JSON>>>
